Name: SinZational Spending Services
Author: SinZ163
Description:
This is a simple mod that exposes the ability to do the split money multiplayer transfer from a keybind (F6) instead of needing to go to the manor.

Known issues:
[list=1]
[*]Functionality isn't disabled when the farm isn't on split funds
[/list]
Upcoming changes:
[list=1]
[*]Move it from a hardcoded F6 to Config, and add GMCM support.
[/list]

Source: https://github.com/SinZ163/StardewMods
